body:
this is the lover set from the eras tour and i will never be normal about it — head-to-toe pastel, the softest she's ever let an era look. 💗

okay but the lover deep cut i can't stop thinking about: the children you hear on 'it's nice to have a friend' are a real youth choir from toronto's regent park school of music. taylor pulled the sample from a library her producer frank dukes built on purpose — so that the royalties flow back and fund the school.

so the album's tiniest, quietest closing track is secretly paying a kids' music program's bills. every single play helps keep it running. she tucked a good deed into the last minutes of the record and never made a thing of it.

that's the whole era to me. soft on the outside, quietly doing the most.

(pictured: the lover act of the eras tour, minneapolis 2023 — photo by michael hicks, cc by 2.0, via wikimedia commons)
